mapper.sql: w.wl_id, w.user_id, w.work_day, w.proj_id, p.proj_no, p.proj_nm, w.task_id, t.task_nm as wbs_task_nm, w.category_cd, w.hours, w.entry_method, w.status, w.confirmed_at, w.reopen_reason, w.note, w.row_ver
mapper.select: select from pms_work_log w join pms_project p on p.proj_id = w.proj_id left join pms_task t on t.task_id = w.task_id where w.user_id = #{userId} and w.work_day between #{from} and #{to} order by w.work_day, p.proj_no, w.wl_id

select p.proj_id, p.proj_no, p.proj_nm, t.task_id, t.task_nm, t.plan_start, t.plan_end, t.status from pms_task t join pms_project p on p.proj_id = t.proj_id where t.owner_user_id = #{userId} and t.is_summary = 'N' and p.status = 'ACTIVE' and (t.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' or (t.status = 'NOT_STARTED' and #{day} between t.plan_start and t.plan_end)) order by p.proj_no, t.plan_start, t.task_id limit 50
select proj_id, proj_no, proj_nm from pms_project where status in ('DRAFT', 'ACTIVE', 'ON_HOLD') order by proj_no desc limit 500

select w.wl_id, w.hours, w.category_cd, w.work_day from pms_work_log w where w.user_id = #{userId} and w.proj_id = #{projId} and w.task_id is not distinct from #{taskId} and w.work_day < #{day} and w.work_day >= #{day}::date - 14 and w.hours > 0 order by w.work_day desc, w.wl_id desc limit 1

insert into pms_work_log (comp_cd, user_id, work_day, proj_id, task_id, category_cd, hours, entry_method, note, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{userId}, #{day}, #{projId}, #{taskId}, #{categoryCd}, #{hours}, #{method}, #{note}, #{by}, #{by}) returning wl_id
mapper.update: update pms_work_log set task_id = #{taskId}, category_cd = #{categoryCd}, hours = #{hours}, entry_method = #{method}, note = #{note}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where wl_id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.delete: delete from pms_work_log where wl_id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: select w.user_id, u.login_id, u.user_nm, w.category_cd, trim_scale(coalesce(sum(w.hours) filter (where w.status = 'CONFIRMED'), 0)) as confirmed_hours, trim_scale(coalesce(sum(w.hours) filter (where w.status = 'DRAFT'), 0)) as draft_hours, min(w.work_day) as first_day, max(w.work_day) as last_day from pms_work_log w join sys_user u on u.user_id = w.user_id where w.proj_id = #{projId} group by w.user_id, u.login_id, u.user_nm, w.category_cd order by u.user_nm, w.category_cd
mapper.sql: i.issue_id, i.issue_no, i.proj_id, p.proj_no, p.proj_nm, i.task_id, t.task_nm, i.title, i.detail, i.severity, i.status, i.issue_type, i.close_kind, i.owner_user_id, u.login_id as owner_login_id, u.user_nm as owner_nm, i.due_date, i.resolution, i.resolved_on, i.source, i.gate_review_id, r.review_no as gate_review_no, i.obj_type, i.obj_id, case i.obj_type when 'ITEM' then it.item_cd when 'CUST' then c.cust_cd when 'EQUIP' then e.equip_cd when 'ASSET' then a.asset_cd end as obj_cd, case i.obj_type when 'ITEM' then it.item_nm when 'CUST' then c.cust_nm when 'EQUIP' then e.equip_nm when 'ASSET' then a.asset_nm end as obj_nm, i.capa_id, i.row_ver, i.created_at, i.created_by, i.updated_at, i.updated_by, (i.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and i.due_date < #{lateRef}) as late
